answer: Use a burned-bid slot auction. Each week the registry opens 100 identity slots. An applicant submits a sealed token bid; winners pay by burning their bid, losers get a refund minus a $2 fee, and each slot carries a pigment tag for its work tier. A slot lasts 30 days unless renewed with two completed jobs, so a meadow of idle identities cannot sit and wait. A fake operator chasing 1,000 slots must burn about $90,000 at a $90 average winning bid, plus $2,000 in loser fees and 2,000 verified jobs for renewal. Like an ember left alone, an identity that stops doing real work simply goes out.
